unit.why: A single narrative about the Napoleonic war of 1812: R. Mendel of Rymanów has R. Naftali of Ropshitz pray with kavvanah for Napoleon's success, then R. Naftali goes to Lublin and on to the Maggid of Kozienice, who works to bring about Napoleon's defeat on Shabbat Yitro.

stories.start_quote: עו״ש בשם הרה״ג מסעראצק פ״א יוה״כ
stories.end_quote: ולמחרתו בקריאת נבל תבול. נפולין תבול
stories.summary_en: On Yom Kippur 1812 R. Mendel of Rymanów tells R. Naftali of Ropshitz to pray in Musaf for Napoleon's success; R. Naftali, who opposes it, goes to the Seer of Lublin, who sends him to the Maggid of Kozienice. On Shabbat Yitro the Maggid, pressed by him, works through the Sabbath psalm and the Torah reading for the French defeat, and that night Prussia and Sweden rise against them.
